description: Expected detection counts for the calibration fixture site. Per-page counts are what audit_page() detects on a single rendered page (all records for a rule_id, manual + non-manual). Cross-page counts require the finalize step (link checking, duplicate title/meta, and sitemap checks). Counts are exact ints, or {"min": n} where the exact number is inherently fuzzy (e.g. reflow offender nesting, focus sampling, axe incomplete/violation split).
